name: Illuminate
description: Illuminate (AILuminate v1.0/v1.1) is a collaborative AI risk and reliability benchmark developed by MLCommons that evaluates the safety of general-purpose AI chat models. It tests text-to-text responses across 12 hazard categories (malicious use, self-harm, etc.) using prompts from naive or moderately knowledgeable users, with automated grading by other AI evaluators. The benchmark supports both safety assessment and emerging agentic reliability testing.
typical_sota_score: Very Good (top models like Claude 3.5/4 series)
reputation: Industry-standard collaborative benchmark involving leading AI companies, academia, and civil society; widely adopted for LLM safety evaluation and policy guidance.
notes: Emphasizes real-world product safety over raw capability; low contamination risk due to adversarial design but evolves with new hazards.
